summary.status: PH1 세부 명세 작성; 정본 및 행별 채택 미확정; PH0 gate와 온라인 시험 대기

common_rules.no_facts_created: Schemas/route conditions only. No source records migrated and no online mutation.
common_rules.id_policy: Existing identifier bytes preserved. New relation/observation record IDs are fixed once and stored against legacy_locator; no row-number formula IDs. Existing source IDs separately retained if namespaced collisions exist.
common_rules.temporal: World dates stored as route/calendar_revision/era/year/month/day/precision; 48 months and 30 days only when the C00 approved revision supports it. Never Gregorian DATE. Exact intervals [start,end); year-only end includes year for annual query without invented month/day. Unknown end differs from ongoing and preserves recorded-start-only behavior.
common_rules.nullable_numbers: Blank numeric cell remains blank; confirmed zero is numeric 0 plus value status. Unparseable or overprecision original retained verbatim. Never fill IFERROR result with 0.
common_rules.validation_scope: Duplicate candidates not automatically deleted. All nonempty literal records, formula-only templates and defaults separated. Old statuses/results do not become V2 tests.
common_rules.single_input: One table per fact type; annual presentation and labels are read-only derivatives. R50 owns territory, R10 owns regions/facilities, R20 population, R60 production, R70 reserves.
common_rules.range_growth: For every registered dataset, update input capacity, calculated range, validation rules, named publication range, import range and consumer lookup together; test last existing row, first new row and overflow alert in TEST copy.
common_rules.no_cycles: R10<-C00; R20<-C00,R10; R30/R40<-C00,R10,optional R20; R50<-C00,R10; R70<-C00,R10; R60<-C00,R10,optional R20,R70. H90 alone combines production/reserve and reverse cross-checks. No owner imports H90.
